title: Part (2 parts)
spec:
Start by creating a new coordinate system for the first part, setting the Euler angles to zero and the translation vector to zero. Draw the first face using a loop that consists of four lines: the first line starts at the origin (0.0, 0.0) and ends at (0.025, 0.0); the second line runs from (0.025, 0.0) to (0.025, 0.75); the third line goes from (0.025, 0.75) to (0.0, 0.75); and the fourth line completes the loop by returning from (0.0, 0.75) to the origin. Apply a sketch scale of 0.75 to the entire loop. Transform the scaled sketch into three-dimensional space using the same Euler angles and translation vector. Extrude the two-dimensional sketch 0.025 units along the normal direction to create a solid body. The final dimensions of this part are a length of 0.024999999999999988 units, a width of 0.75 units, and a height of 0.025 units.

For the second part, create another new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero and a translation vector of (0.0084, 0.0, 0.025). Draw the first face using a loop with four lines: the first line starts at (0.0, 0.0) and ends at (0.0081, 0.0); the second line runs from (0.0081, 0.0) to (0.0081, 0.75); the third line goes from (0.0081, 0.75) to (0.0, 0.75); and the fourth line completes the loop by returning from (0.0, 0.75) to the origin. Apply a sketch scale of 0.75 to the entire loop. Transform the scaled sketch into three-dimensional space using the same Euler angles and translation vector. Extrude the two-dimensional sketch 0.0125 units in the opposite direction of the normal to remove material from the existing body. The final dimensions of this part are a length of 0.008149999999999998 units, a width of 0.75 units, and a height of 0.0125 units.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Part 1: Create the rectangular extrusion
part_1 = cq.Workplane("XY").moveTo(0, 0).lineTo(0.025, 0).lineTo(0.025, 0.75).lineTo(0, 0.75).close().extrude(0.025)

# Part 2: Create the rectangular cutout
part_2 = cq.Workplane("XY").moveTo(0.0084, 0).lineTo(0.0165, 0).lineTo(0.0165, 0.75).lineTo(0.0084, 0.75).close().extrude(-0.0125)

# Translate part_2 to the correct position
part_2 = part_2.translate((0, 0, 0.025))

# Combine part_1 and part_2
r = part_1.cut(part_2)

import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Define the sketch
r = r.moveTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.75, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.75, 0.025) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.025) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .close() \
     .moveTo(0.0062, 0.0062) \
     .lineTo(0.0188, 0.0062) \
     .lineTo(0.0188, 0.0188) \
     .lineTo(0.0062, 0.0188) \
     .lineTo(0.0062, 0.0062) \
     .close() \
     .moveTo(0.0188, 0.0062) \
     .lineTo(0.025, 0.0062) \
     .lineTo(0.025, 0.0188) \
     .lineTo(0.0188, 0.0188) \
     .lineTo(0.0188, 0.0062) \
     .close()

# Extrude the sketch
r = r.extrude(0.025)

import cadquery as cq

# U-channel profile in the XZ plane, extruded along Y
# Outer: 0.025 wide (X), 0.025 tall (Z), length 0.75 (Y)
# Wall thickness: 0.005, slot width: 0.015, slot depth: 0.020 (open at top)

profile = (
    cq.Workplane("XZ")
    .moveTo(0.0, 0.0)
    .lineTo(0.025, 0.0)
    .lineTo(0.025, 0.025)
    .lineTo(0.020, 0.025)
    .lineTo(0.020, 0.005)
    .lineTo(0.005, 0.005)
    .lineTo(0.005, 0.025)
    .lineTo(0.0, 0.025)
    .close()
)

r = profile.extrude(0.75)
